soldier: Two forms, large and small. Large form darker in colour, antennae with 13 segments; small form paler, antennae with 12 segments. Head pale, nasus brown tinged with reddish, antennae brown, anterior part of the pronotum brown, meso- and metanotal plates and abdominal tergites and legs pale yellow tinged with brown. Head hairs very sparse, almost glabrous: a single short bristle on each side behind the vertex and on each side of the base of the nasus, several short hairs at the tip of the nasus, the short fine hairs on the anterior part of the nasus very dense; short hairs on the abdominal tergites sparse, the hairs of the sternites longer.
worker: Molar plate with about seven ridges. Antennae with 12 to 13 segments, the fourth shortest, the third larger than or equal in length to the second. Postmentum hexagonal, strongly arched in the middle of its posterior half. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 2.9 times as wide as long, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle, the posterior margin without an incision. Hind femur extending beyond the midpoint of the abdomen.
